text: APPROVE. The patch moves the whole container-construction block, including its ternaries, `&&`/`||` chains and lambda, unchanged into a private static `ToContainer`. That lowers `Parse`'s complexity, and the call is still inside the same `try`, so exceptions are caught as before. I couldn't build or run anything here, so the build is judged only from the diff: `ToContainer` is a static member of the same class and uses only members the diff shows or that already existed, so no new warnings are expected.
